title: Redirect Manifest Compiler
description: Compiles the URL redirect manifest. Enforces: no redirect loops, no redirect chains (A→B→C), valid HTTP status codes (301/302/307/308/410), no self-redirects, and proper URL format for all source and destination entries.

error_codes.RDR001: redirect-manifest.json missing or invalid — required fields: redirects[] with from, to, status
error_codes.RDR002: Redirect loop detected — A redirects to B which redirects back to A; loops cause browser errors
error_codes.RDR003: Redirect chain detected — A redirects to B which redirects to C; flatten chains to single-hop redirects
error_codes.RDR004: Invalid HTTP status code — redirect status must be one of: 301, 302, 307, 308, 410
error_codes.RDR005: Self-redirect detected — source and destination URL are identical; remove this entry
error_codes.RDR006: Invalid URL format — source and destination must be valid absolute or root-relative URLs
